name: Will of the Jeskai
oracle_text:
Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead.
• Each player may discard their hand and draw five cards.
• Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.

needs.what: an effect that gives cards already in a graveyard the flashback alternative cost -- castable from the graveyard for a cost derived per card (here each card's own mana cost), exiled instead of going to the graveyard as it resolves -- with a duration, so 'until end of turn' and 'for as long as this permanent is on the battlefield' (Lier, Disciple of the Drowned) are both sayable
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `flashback` is a card_level_cost_key -- a field a card carries about itself -- and no op writes it onto another card. `grant_keyword` only takes the 34 ability keywords and flashback is not one of them; `grant_ability` attaches an activated/triggered/static ability, but flashback is an alternative cost to CAST the card, not an ability, and no `cost_keys` entry can price itself at 'its mana cost'. `grant_playable` (any_type/limit/objects) would let the cards be played but carries no alternative cost and no exile-on-resolution replacement, so it silently gives a strictly better, repeatable effect. The static_effect `cast_from_graveyard` is the closest semantics, but it is a static ability on a permanent -- it cannot be produced by a sorcery's `spell_effects` with a duration, and it likewise omits the exile replacement and the cost.

notes: The other two lines are expressible and are not blocked. The conditional mode count -- 'Choose one. If you control a commander as you cast this spell, you may choose both instead' -- is `choose_mode` with `count: 1` plus `up_to_if` on an `exists` condition over `{controller: you, zone: battlefield, is_commander: true}`; `up_to_if` is in choose_mode's op_options, so a mode count may depend on the board as the spell is cast. Mode 1 is `for_each_player` -> `may` -> `discard` the hand + `draw` 5. Only the flashback-granting mode blocks the card.
